cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your woodwork prize card: 'Congratulations. A lovely year for forgiving judges.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you saying I didn't deserve it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cross out 'forgiving.' 'Beautiful work. Mine took far more sanding.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on showing us how little sanding a winner needs.
